title: 第9章 林府扬名第10章 开辟灵脉
content_zh:
第9章林府扬名
“什么？楚风眠怎么会突然出现在林莫身后。”
“刚刚楚风眠不是还被林莫打的节节败退吗？我不是眼了吧。”
惊异之声，不断响起。
庭院之外的那些林府弟子，都有些无法相信眼前的一幕，瞪大双眼，想要弄清楚到底怎么回事。
就在刚刚，众人所看的，还是楚风眠被林莫追击，可几乎一个瞬息之间，楚风眠便是来到了林莫的身后，将林莫一拳击败。
这其中到底发生了什么，就连他们亲眼所见，都有些无法理解。
刚刚，好像是出现了两个楚风眠一样。
也只有楚风眠自己清楚，刚刚到底发生了什么。
虚影。
刚刚被林莫打的节节败退的楚风眠，其实便是楚风眠利用魅影身法凝聚而出的一道虚影。
这一道虚影，却是半虚半实，有着楚风眠全数的力量，但是只能维持三秒。
就在刚刚，这道虚影跟林莫两拳相对，其中蕴含的力量，才让林莫觉得这虚影便是楚风眠本体，以至于追击，没有察觉到楚风眠本体已经是偷偷绕到林莫的身后去。
一拳便是将林莫彻底击败。
这魅影身法，可是武胜大陆最强的几道身法之一，修炼到大成，凝聚出来的虚影都可以持续数天左右。
以现在楚风眠的实力，只能是持续三秒左右，但是也足以一击将林莫击败。
“你们积攒的丹药在哪里。”
楚风眠走到倒地的林莫面前，一脚踩在了林莫的胸口之上。
本来便是灵脉破碎的林莫，在这一脚之下，口中吐出了不少鲜血。
“不…知…道。”

林莫口中断断续续的说道。
“不说？”
楚风眠眼神之中露出几分杀意，他的脚，再一次抬起，踩在了林莫的胸口之上。
这一脚，楚风眠更是催动了灵力，一脚下去，林莫几乎感觉到他自己身躯的内脏都要被踩了出来。
半条命都要没了。
“在，在房间的床下。”
这一次林莫可不敢在隐瞒下去了，他也看出来了，现在的楚风眠已经是跟以前截然不同了，这等心狠手辣，要是他不说，今日可能真的死在楚风眠的脚下。
灵脉破碎，还有办法医治，但是要是人死了，可就再也没有办法活了。
“滚。”
楚风眠瞥了一眼林莫，一脚也是对着林莫踢了过去，将林莫踢到了庭院之外。
“以后这庭院，便是属于楚某的了。”
一声冰冷言语，庭院外围观的那些林府弟子，几乎全部仓皇退去。
这一战，令楚风眠在林府外府的名声彻底响亮起来，能够击败林莫，林叶二人，楚风眠现在的实力，已经是站在了林府外府的高端。
比起他们二人还强大的，也就只有林府外府的副总管林阳。
在林府外府的第一强者，便是李星，淬骨境七重巅峰武者。
李家，可是林府外府第一大家族，林府内部，都是由林家中人担任要职，而这林府外府，却都是一些依附于林家的家族。
其中的李家，便是外府其中一大家族，这李星那是李家第一天才，年纪轻轻便是已经踏入到淬骨境七重。
content_en:
Chapter 9 Lin Mansion becomes famous
"What? Why did Chu Fengmian suddenly appear behind Lin Mo?"
"Isn't it true that Chu Fengmian was defeated by Lin Mo just now? I'm blind, right?"
The sounds of surprise kept ringing out.
The disciples of the Lin Mansion outside the courtyard couldn't believe what they were seeing, and their eyes widened, trying to figure out what was going on.
Just now, what everyone was watching was Chu Fengmian being chased by Lin Mo. But almost in an instant, Chu Fengmian came behind Lin Mo and defeated Lin Mo with one punch.
What exactly happened, even what they saw with their own eyes, was somewhat incomprehensible.
Just now, it seemed like two Chu Fengmian appeared.
Only Chu Fengmian knew what exactly happened just now.
Shadow.
Chu Fengmian, who had just been beaten by Lin Mo, was actually a phantom formed by Chu Fengmian using his phantom body technique.
This phantom was half virtual and half real, possessing Chu Fengmian's full power, but it could only last for three seconds.
Just now, this phantom was facing Lin Mo's fists, and the power contained in it made Lin Mo think that the phantom was Chu Fengmian's true form, so he pursued him, not realizing that Chu Fengmian's true form had sneaked around behind Lin Mo.
Lin Mo was completely defeated with one punch.
This phantom body technique is one of the strongest in Wusheng Continent. Once practiced to a great level, the condensed shadow can last for several days.
With Chu Fengmian's current strength, he could only last for about three seconds, but it was enough to defeat Lin Mo with one blow.
"Where are the elixirs you have accumulated?"
Chu Fengmian walked up to Lin Mo who fell to the ground and stepped on Lin Mo's chest.
Lin Mo, whose spiritual veins were originally broken, spat out a lot of blood under this kick.
"I don't know."
Lin Mo said intermittently.
"Don't tell?"
Chu Fengmian's eyes showed some murderous intent, and he raised his foot again and stepped on Lin Mo's chest.
With this kick, Chu Fengmian activated his spiritual power even more. With one kick, Lin Mo almost felt that his own internal organs were being stepped out.
Half my life is gone.
"Here, under the bed in the room."
Lin Mo didn't dare to hide it anymore this time. He also saw that Chu Fengmian was completely different from before. He was so cruel and ruthless. If he hadn't told her, he might have died at Chu Fengmian's feet today.
There are ways to heal a broken spiritual vein, but if a person dies, there is no way to live anymore.
"Get lost."
Chu Fengmian glanced at Lin Mo and kicked Lin Mo out of the courtyard.
"From now on, this courtyard will belong to Chu."
With a cold word, almost all the Lin Mansion disciples watching from the outside of the courtyard retreated hastily.
This battle made Chu Fengmian's reputation in the Lin Mansion's outer palace completely resounding. Being able to defeat Lin Mo and Lin Ye, Chu Fengmian's current strength was already at the high end of the Lin Mansion's outer palace.
The only person more powerful than the two of them was Lin Yang, the deputy general manager of the Lin Mansion.
The most powerful person in the outer palace of Lin Mansion is Li Xing, a warrior at the seventh level of the Bone Tempering Realm.
The Li family is the largest family outside the Lin family. Within the Lin family, members of the Lin family hold important positions, but outside the Lin family, they are all families that are dependent on the Lin family.
Among them, the Li family is one of the major families in the outer palace. Li Xing is the number one genius of the Li family. He has already reached the seventh level of the Bone Tempering Realm at a young age.
